# Curv design system — llms.txt

Shared npm package `@curvgroup/design-system`. Do not copy files into the app. Do not invent layouts.

## Page shells (required)

Humans describe the job in plain language. Map:

- list / table / queue / catalog → ListPage (header, optional SummaryStrip, DataTable). No KPI wall.
- product / deal / customer / SKU / one record → DetailPage (tabs, header, verdict, max 4 vitals on the strip, tab body, optional Drawer). Not a section home (Analytics, Marketing).
- overview / dashboard / home → DashboardPage (max 5 KPIs, max 2 charts, optional table). Tabs only when there is more than one job.
- P&L / statement / landing-page performance / workbook → ReportPage (header, one ChartCard, one table, optional Drawer for a row peek)
- settings / form → SettingsPage (narrow Field stack)

Copy examples/list-page.tsx (and siblings). One fitting job: examples/dashboard-page.tsx (no tabs). Two named jobs: examples/dashboard-page-tabs.tsx. Chart + long table + row peek: examples/report-page-performance.tsx. Wire real data. Do not add sections.

## Tabs — count jobs

- One job that fits → no page tabs.
- Overflow (6th KPI, 3rd chart, extra table) → a tab, not more cards.
- N named jobs → N tabs. Each tab is still one shell.
- Never invent Overview / Reporting / Marketing unless the prompt named those jobs.
- Table chips stay on DataTable. Row peek = Drawer, not a new route.

## Hard limits

- DetailPage.vitals ≤ 4 (the strip, not the whole screen)
- DashboardPage.kpis ≤ 5, charts ≤ 2. A 17-card wall is wrong; pick 5 headlines.
- Extra fields → tab, Drawer, or StatCard breakdown. Never a data wall.

## Chrome

AppFrame + TopBar + Sidebar. Tokens only (bg-card, text-muted-foreground, verdict-*). No hex, no bg-neutral-100.

## Page titles

PageHeader: title + optional count/badge + actions. No eyebrow. No description. If the title is unclear, rename it.

## Tools

- Cheatsheet: docs/cheatsheet.md
- Skill: skills/curv-ui/SKILL.md
- MCP: npx @curvgroup/design-system mcp (search, compose_page, get_component, get_examples, validate_usage, get_agent_skill)
- Installer: npx @curvgroup/design-system init-agent
